title: Ride-sharing legalised and taxi fees cut (ACT)
summary: From 30 October 2015 interim regulations permitted regulated ride-sharing and transport booking services in Canberra, subject to driver and vehicle safety requirements, with taxi and hire-car fees reduced.

instruments.title: Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) (Exemptions) Amendment Regulation 2015 (No 1)
instruments.provisions: Interim exemptions permitting ridesharing and booking services

commenced.what: Interim arrangements permitting ridesharing and booking services commenced

direction_rationale: Legalising app-based ride-share removes the legal barrier to entry created by taxi/hire-car licence quotas, adding a new type of supplier and price competition in point-to-point transport.
comparison: States that had not yet legalised ride-sharing (ACT Oct 2015 first, NT Dec 2017/Feb 2018 last)
confounders: taxi licence compensation and per-trip levies
ABN registration by gig drivers inflates business counts
notes: First Australian jurisdiction to regulate ride-sharing; Canberra has its own CPI capital-city series.

verified.notes: Announcement date (late Sept/early Oct 2015) only in news reports; left null.
